commit_message:
Used `MoreElements.isAnnotationPresent()` instead

Removed `isAnnotationPresent()` method and used `MoreElements.isAnnotationPresent()` instead.

`List` makes more sense for defining `steps`

Replaced `ImmutableSet` with `ImmutableList` when defining the steps, because I believe it is more natural for the `steps` to have ordering than not (as conveyed by its name as well).
Element kind should not be checked by instanceof
